blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Exploring a scene from as little as a single photo requires generating a long, camera-controlled walkthrough that extends far beyond what was captured, yet remains consistent upon return. Memory-based video generation methods preserve what they have already seen, but have no anchor beyond it, where the camera drifts from its path and a text prompt can name objects but not place them. Layout-conditioned methods provide such an anchor and precise control over what appears where, but rely on layouts that are typically authored by hand. Both limitations arise because, beyond what was captured, nothing anchors the video model unless a human authors one. To overcome both, we propose Lyris, a long video generation framework that never leaves the video model without an anchor: a persistent point-cloud memory where the scene has been observed or generated, and a 3D layout that a vision-language model authors where it has not. Our key insight is that the interface between the two models can be surprisingly coarse. A layout of one labeled 3D box per object is simple enough for a vision-language model to author (and for a user to edit), yet expressive enough for a video model to follow once rendered along the camera path. We demonstrate walkthroughs of over three minutes and 50 meters from a single photo, passing through doorways into rooms it never shows. When evaluated on minute-long round trips across four datasets, Lyris outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a wide margin, reducing camera error by 3.8x and improving consistency upon return by 22% on average.
blocks.zh: 探索一个场景,只要只拍一张照片,就需要制作一个长长的摄像机控制通道,它远远超出所捕捉到的场景,但返回后仍保持一致。 基于记忆的视频生成方法保存着他们已经看到的东西,但除了它之外没有锚,摄影机漂移到它的路径上,一个文本提示可以命名物体,但不能放置它们. 以布局为条件的方法提供了这种锚地和对出现地点的精确控制,但依靠通常由手写的布局。 这两种限制都产生,因为除了捕捉到的东西之外,除了人类的作者之外,没有任何东西可以锁定视频模型。 为了克服两者,我们提出Lyris,一个长长的视频生成框架,从不让视频模型没有主播:一个持续的点-云记忆,在现场被观察或生成,以及一个3D布局,一个没有视觉语言模型作者. 我们的关键见解是,这两个模型之间的接口可能令人惊讶地粗糙。 每个对象一个标注3D框的布局,对于一个视觉语言模型来说足够简单,可以让作者(以及一个用户编辑),但足够表现,可以让一个视频模型随相机路径一经渲染就遵循. 我们展示出超过3分钟和50米 从一张照片, 穿过门道进入房间 它从来没有显示。 在经过四套数据集的短时间往返评估时,赖瑞斯的成绩比最先进的方法远,将相机误差减少3.8x,在返回时平均提高22%的一致性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Virtual touring [ 61 ] , content creation, and simulation for physical AI [ 62 , 4 ] benefit from 3D environments that can be explored freely. Creating such environments from as little as a single photo requires generating a long, camera-controlled walkthrough beyond the captured view, passing through doorways and into unseen rooms. These regions must form a plausible extension of the observed scene and retain their layout and appearance when the camera returns.
blocks.zh: 虚拟游览[61],内容创建,以及物理AI的模拟[62,4]从可自由探索的3D环境中受益. 创造这种环境就像一张相片一样少,需要用相机控制的长长行走,超越所摄取的视野,穿过门道并进入看不见的房间。 这些地区必须形成可视的被观测场景的延伸并保持相机返回时的布局和外观.

blocks.en:
Recent video generative models [ 60 , 51 , 52 ] can generate photorealistic clips from an image and a text prompt, but only seconds at a time.
Memory-based methods extend them to long rollouts by conditioning each new chunk on the history, through compressed or retrieved past views [ 86 , 41 , 57 , 29 ] , learned implicit representations [ 88 , 72 ] , or explicitly reconstructed geometry [ 95 , 12 , 49 ] .
This memory preserves what has already been seen but offers nothing beyond it.
There, the camera path reaches the model only as a pose encoding [ 57 , 90 ] , a far weaker signal than rendered geometry [ 54 , 10 ] , and the camera drifts from its path as unseen regions accumulate.
The content of the unseen regions is left to the text prompt, which can name objects and relate them coarsely, but cannot specify where they belong or how one space connects to the next.
Layout-conditioned methods instead condition generation on an explicit scene layout, such as untextured geometry, object boxes, or maps [ 36 , 5 , 48 ] , and offer precise control over the spatial arrangement of the objects.
However, these methods take the layout as an input, typically authored by hand, which does not scale to open-ended exploration.

近期的视频基因模型[60,51,52]可以从一幅图像和一出文字的快取出相片现实主义的片段,但一次只能产生几秒钟.
基于记忆的方法通过对历史的每个新块进行调节,通过压缩或检索过去的观点[86、41、57、29]、学到的隐含表述[88、72],或通过明确重建几何[95、12、49],将其扩展至长期展开。
这种记忆保存了已经看到的东西,但除了它之外没有其他东西。
在那里,相机路径仅作为姿势编码[57,90]而到达模型,这个信号远远弱于被制成几何[54,10],相机会随着看不见的区域累积而从它的路径漂移.
看不见区域的内容留给文本提示,它可以命名对象并粗略地将其连接起来,但不能指定它们属于何处或一个空间如何连接到下一个区域。
以布局为条件的方法代替以明显的场景布局为条件生成,如无文字几何,物体盒,或地图[36,5,48],并且对物体的空间安排提供精确的控制.
然而,这些方法将布局作为投入,一般是用手书写的,这种布局不能被规模化为开放式的探索.

blocks.en:
To overcome both limitations, we propose Lyris, a long video generation framework in which a vision-language model authors the layout of unseen regions before a video model generates them.
Our key insight is that the interface between the two models can be surprisingly coarse: a 3D layout with one labeled bounding box per object [ 22 , 80 , 58 ] is simple enough for a vision-language model to author (and for a user to edit), yet expressive enough for a video model to follow.
We fine-tune a pretrained video diffusion model to follow renderings of this layout, which specify what appears where and anchor the camera to its path, even in unseen regions.
To remain consistent upon return, we reconstruct each generated chunk and write it into a persistent point-cloud memory, which conditions every subsequent chunk alongside the layout.
The resulting loop between explicit 3D geometry and photorealistic video generation extends the walkthrough far beyond the photo, as the layout and the memory condition each chunk, and each generated chunk in turn extends the memory from which the next layout is planned.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Camera-controlled video generation. Video diffusion models [ 28 ] generate photorealistic clips [ 8 , 82 , 73 , 60 ] and increasingly accept multimodal conditions [ 56 , 51 , 52 ] .
To control the viewpoint, existing methods inject per-frame camera poses [ 71 ] or dense Plücker ray embeddings [ 26 , 77 ] , often through dedicated conditioning branches [ 2 , 1 ] , and extend beyond single clips by conditioning each new clip on frames of the preceding one [ 27 ] .
Geometry-guided approaches instead condition on point-cloud renderings at the target views [ 89 , 54 , 10 , 87 ] , couple implicit reconstruction of the input views with generation [ 39 ] , or repair renderings of imperfect reconstructions [ 74 , 14 ] .
These methods guide generation where geometry has been observed, but leave the content of unobserved regions to the generative prior.
SpatialCrafter [ 19 ] instead generates the geometry of these regions with a 3D generator conditioned on the input image alone, whereas Lyris lays them out as labeled boxes that a vision-language model can write and a user can edit.
blocks.zh:
相机控制视频生成. 视频传播模式[28]产生相片现实主义片段[8,82,73,60]并日益接受多式条件[56,51,52].
为了控制观点,现行注射每帧相机的方法提出[71]或密集的Plücker射线嵌入[26,77],往往通过专用的调节分枝[2,1]来进行,并通过在前一相机相机的相机框上为每个新相机进行调节来延伸出单片. [27].
取而代之的是几何制导方法,条件是在目标视点[89、54、10、87]上以点-云渲染为条件,用生成[39]来对输入值进行一对隐含重建,或对不完美的重建进行修复[74、14]。
这些方法指导了已观测到几何的生成,但将未观测到的区域的内容留给先基因.
SpaceCrafter [19] 转而生成这些区域的几何图形,一个仅以输入图像为条件的3D生成器,而Lyris则将它们打出被标注的框,一个视觉语言模型可以写出,一个用户可以编辑.

blocks.en:
Scene memory for long video generation. To generate long videos, memory-based methods condition each new frame or chunk on previously observed or generated content.
Many approaches compress this history into a limited token budget [ 92 , 29 , 11 , 72 ] or retrieve its most relevant parts [ 86 , 76 , 41 , 81 ] .
However, the model must still infer how this history maps to the target view, which often fails under large viewpoint changes [ 57 ] .
A second line of work addresses this by aligning the history with the target camera before generation [ 13 , 57 , 90 , 88 ] , or by maintaining scene geometry that is rendered into the target views [ 54 , 75 , 95 , 94 , 33 , 12 , 49 , 59 ] .
Although rendering aligns the memory with each target view, errors can accumulate in the geometry itself [ 94 , 49 , 59 ] .
Other methods instead generate and simulate an editable latent 3D scene around the agent, albeit trained with ground-truth 3D supervision in a voxel game [ 24 ] , or sample all views jointly in a geometry-native latent space [ 47 ] .
Whatever its form, however, a memory of past frames preserves what has already been seen but offers nothing beyond it.
There, the camera can only be conveyed through pose encodings [ 57 , 90 ] , which control it far less precisely than rendered geometry [ 54 , 10 ] .
The content, in turn, is left to the text prompt.
Lyris also maintains an explicit point-cloud memory, but pairs it with a 3D layout of the objects that unseen regions should contain.
Rendered into the same target views, this layout anchors the camera where the memory is empty and leaves the appearance of these objects, but no longer their placement, to the generative prior.
As the generated views follow their requested cameras more closely, they also align more reliably with the memory, limiting the errors that accumulate in its geometry.
blocks.zh:
场景记忆为长相视频生成. 为了生成长视频,基于内存的方法将每个新框架或块入以前观察到或生成的内容作为条件.
许多方法将这一历史压缩为有限的象征性预算[92、29、11、72]或检索其最相关的部分[86、76、41、81]。
然而,模型仍然必须推断这个历史图如何映射到目标视图,在大视角下往往失败的视角变化[57].
第二行的工作通过使历史与目标相机在生成前[13, 57, 90, 88],或者通过保持将场景几何化成目标视点[54, 75, 95, 94, 33, 12, 49, 59]来解决这个问题.
虽然渲染使内存与每个目标视图一致,但误差可以在几何本身中积累[94,49,59].
其他方法则在代理商周围生成并模拟一个可编辑的潜在3D场景,尽管在Voxel游戏中训练了地面-真实的3D监督[24],或者在几何-内在的潜入空间中联合抽样所有视图[47].
然而,不管其形式如何,对过去框架的记忆都保留了已经看到的东西,但除此之外却无济于事。
在那里,相机只能通过姿势编码来传递[57,90],相机的控制精确度远低于被制成的几何 [54,10].
内容则留给文本提示。
Lyris还保持了明显的点-云存储器,但将其与不可见区域应包含的物体的3D布局相配.
这种布局将内存为空的相机固定在同一个目标视图中,并将这些物体的外观,但不再将其放置于先基因.
由于所生成的视图更紧密地跟随所请求的相机,它们也更可靠地与内存相接,限制了其几何中积累出的错误.

blocks.en:
Layout-conditioned generation. Scene structure is an effective control signal when it is available in advance.
Generative renderers turn animated proxy meshes [ 9 ] , 3D tracking videos [ 25 ] , coarse geometry [ 36 ] , or depth rendered by a game engine [ 50 ] into realistic or stylized video.
Although some remain consistent even when a region is revisited [ 25 , 50 ] , they all require this structure to be modeled or captured beforehand.
Looser controls ease this requirement by specifying mainly where content should appear, as boxes for images [ 6 ] or short video clips [ 66 , 67 , 5 ] .
Layout-guided methods similarly generate entire indoor scenes from 3D layouts [ 18 , 55 , 78 ] and street scenes from road maps and object boxes [ 23 , 48 , 4 , 52 ] or street and height maps [ 15 ] .
However, these controls are typically authored by hand or taken from an existing scene or map, which does not scale to open-ended exploration.
Lyris instead conditions on a coarse object layout that a vision-language model writes for unseen regions, along with a persistent memory that keeps revisited regions consistent.
blocks.zh:
布局有条件的一代. 场景结构是提前获得的有效控制信号.
基因渲染器将动画的代理 meshes [9],3D跟踪视频 [25],粗几何 [36],或由游戏引擎所渲染的深度 [50]转化为现实或有风格的视频.
尽管有些区域即使在重新审查[25、50]区域时仍保持一致,但它们都要求事先建立这种结构。
Looser控制器通过主要指定内容应出现在何地来方便这一要求,作为图像[6]或短视频片段的框 [66,67,5].
由布局制导的方法同样从3D布局产生出整个室内场景[18,55,78] 从路线图和物体箱产生出街道场景[23,48,4,52] 从街道和高地图产生出[15].
然而,这些控制通常是用手书写的,或者取自现有的场景或地图,而这种场景或地图的规模并不局限于开放式的探索.
Lyris则以粗糙的物体布局为条件,一种视觉语言模型为看不见的区域写作,同时有一个持续的记忆,使重新审视的区域保持一致。

blocks.en:
Language-driven scene planning. Large language and vision-language models have emerged as effective planners for visual content.
Many systems use them to lay out 3D scenes [ 22 , 80 , 7 , 43 , 58 , 91 , 16 ] , but these scenes inherit the synthetic appearance of the assets and engines that realize them.
Other methods instead direct generative models through language, describing the content to generate next [ 85 , 17 ] or iteratively refining prompts or plans for video generation [ 46 , 79 ] .
Although this avoids synthetic appearance, their plans remain natural language, which can name content but only coarsely describe where it belongs.
Lyris bridges the two: a vision-language model authors a 3D layout of labeled boxes, and a video diffusion model turns it into a photorealistic video.
Closest to our work, recent methods also guide video models with 3D boxes that a language model plans or programs [ 37 , 64 , 34 ] .
However, these boxes direct individual objects and leave the scene around them to the video model, whereas ours lay out the scene beyond the capture.
Concurrent to our work, AgiWorld [ 20 ] also plans unseen regions with a language-model agent, but conveys its layout through the text prompt, a strategy that we find far less effective than rendering the layout ( Sec. 4.4 ).
CoDeR [ 21 ] instead re-creates the entire scene in code, which only approximates what the input image shows, whereas we keep the captured scene and lay out what lies beyond it.
blocks.zh:
由语言驱动的场景规划. 大型语言和视觉语言模式已成为视觉内容的有效规划者。
许多系统使用它们来铺设3D场景[22,80,7,43,58,91,16],但这些场景继承了实现它们的资产和引擎的合成外观.
其他方法则通过语言指导基因模型,描述生成下 [85, 17] 的内容,或迭代地提炼生成视频的提示或计划 [46, 79].
虽然这避免了合成外观,但是他们的计划仍然是自然语言,可以命名内容,但只能粗略地描述它属于何处.
莱瑞斯将两者相接:一个视觉语言模型作者一个被标记的盒子的3D布局,一个视频传播模型将它变成一个相片现实主义的视频.
与我们的工作最接近的是,最近的方法还用3D盒指导视频模型,一个语言模型计划或程序[37,64,34].
然而,这些盒子引导单个物体,并将周围的场景留给了视频模型,而我们的则将场景排出捕捉范围之外.
AgiWorld [20] 也用语言模型代理来规划看不见的区域,
CoDER [21] 转而用代码来再现整个场景,这只相当于输入图像显示的内容,而我们保留了被捕获的场景,并列出它以外的事.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Given one or a few input views, a camera path, and an optional text description of what each part of the path should reveal, our goal is to generate a long video that follows the path far beyond the observed regions, while remaining consistent when the camera returns.
Our solution is a chunk-wise autoregressive video model guided by a 3D layout of labeled object boxes, which a vision-language model plans for unseen regions, and by a persistent point-cloud memory and appearance references.
We describe our object layouts in Sec. 3.1 , our scene memory in Sec. 3.2 , and our video model and its training in Sec. 3.3 . Figure 2 illustrates our overall approach.
blocks.zh:
考虑到一个或几个输入视图,一个相机路径,以及对路径每个部分应当揭示的内容的可选文本描述,我们的目标是生成一个长视频,该视频遵循的路径远远超出被观测区域,同时相机返回时保持一致.
我们的解决方案是一个以标有标记的对象框的3D布局为指导的分块自旋式视频模型,它是一个面向看不见的区域的视觉语言模型计划,以及一个持续的点-云内存和外观参考.
我们用第3.1节描述我们的物体布局,我们用第3.2节描述的场景记忆,以及我们用第3.1节描述的视频模型和它的训练。 3.3 (英语). 图2显示了我们的总体做法。

blocks.en: 3.1 Object Layouts
blocks.zh: 3.1 对象布局

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Layout planning. To keep the layout consistent with the observed scene, the vision-language model first fits boxes to the objects visible in the input view ( a ). It then adds a box for every object that the chunks should reveal, following their descriptions ( b ). To ensure that the layout is physically plausible and visible along the path, we verify the proposal with geometric checks ( c ) and revise the boxes they flag from their proposed positions (dashed in b ) to their final ones. The video model then generates each object where its box places it, such as the vase, which was moved into view ( d ).
blocks.zh: 图3:布局规划。 为了保持布局与所观测到的场景一致,视觉-语言模型首先将框与输入视图(a.)中可见的对象相匹配. 然后,它为块应显示的每个物体添加一个框,按照它们的描述(b.). 为确保布局在实际上合理,并沿路可见,我们用几何检查(c)来核实提案,并修改它们所标出的盒子,从拟议位置(b中标出)改为最终位置。 视频模型然后生成每个对象,如花瓶被移入视图(d.

blocks.en:
Layout representation. We represent the layout as a set ℬ = { 𝐛 i } \mathcal{B}=\{\mathbf{b}_{i}\} of labeled 3D bounding boxes, one per object, where each box 𝐛 i \mathbf{b}_{i} is parameterized by its center 𝐜 i ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{c}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} , size 𝐬 i ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{s}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} , rotation θ i \theta_{i} about the gravity axis, and a text label.
The boxes determine what unseen regions contain and where, and leave the shape and appearance of each object to the video model.
As each box is tied to a single object, a user can also change what is generated by moving or relabeling boxes before generation ( Fig. 6 ).
blocks.zh:
布局说明. 我们代表布局为标有3D边框的设置 B = { bi }\ mathcal{ B}=\{\ mathbf{ b}_{i},每个对象一个,其中每个框 b i\ mathb{ b}_{i}被其中心c参数化 i R 3\ mathbf{ c}_{i}\in\ mathbb{ R}^{3},大小 s∈R 3\ mathbf{ s}_{i}\in\ mathbb{ R}^{3}, 关于重力轴的旋转 θi\theta_{i} 和文本标签.
框会决定隐蔽的区域包含什么以及在何处,并将每个物体的形状和外观留给视频模型.
由于每个框被捆绑在一个单一对象上,用户也可以在生成前改变通过移动或再贴标签所生成的东西(图6.

blocks.en:
Planning. To let the layout build on what has already been generated, we use a vision-language model to plan the layout [ 22 , 80 , 58 ] of what each chunk will reveal right before it is generated ( Fig. 3 ).
The planner receives the chunk’s start frame, the point-cloud memory, the boxes of earlier chunks, and the chunk’s cameras, and thus does not require the full camera path in advance.
To keep the layout consistent with the existing scene, it first estimates a rectangular floor plan that encloses the memory’s points and the chunk’s cameras and fits boxes to the objects visible in the start frame ( Fig. 3 a).
It then determines which objects the chunk should reveal, following its description when one is given, and adds a box for each, placing it relative to the existing boxes and within the floor plan.
blocks.zh:
规划。 为了让布局建立在已经产生的东西上,我们用一种视觉语言模型来规划每个块在产生之前会显示的布局[22,80,58](图3).
计划员收到块的起动框、点-云存储器、更早块的盒和块的相机,因此不需要提前全相机路径。
为了保持布局与现有场景一致,它首先估算出一个长方形地平面图,将内存的分点和块相机相接相机相接并放入起动框所可见的物体(图3 a).
然后,它确定该块应显示的物体,在给出一个块后,再为每个块添加一个框,将其相对于现有框并置于平面图中。

blocks.en:
Verification. To ensure that the layout is physically plausible and visible along the path, we verify the proposal with geometric checks ( Fig. 3 c).
The checks test whether each box is supported, lies within the floor plan and outside observed free space, does not collide with other boxes, is visible from the planned cameras, and satisfies the spatial relations of its description.
We then let the model revise its proposal once, given the violations and renderings of the layout from above and from the planned cameras, and resolve the remaining violations with a deterministic repair ( Fig. 3 b).
We provide details in the supplement.
blocks.zh:
核查。 为确保布局在实际上合理,沿路可见,我们用几何检查来核实提案(图3c)。
检查测试每个盒子是否得到支持,是否位于地板图内和所观察到的自由空间外,不与其他盒子相撞,从计划中的相机中可见,并满足其描述的空间关系.
然后,鉴于上面和计划中的相机对布局的违反和渲染,我们让该模型对其提案作一次修订,并用确定性的修理(图3b)解决其余的违反行为。
我们在补编中提供了细节。

blocks.en:
Layout video and text prompt. We condition the video model on the layout through a layout video, which renders the boxes of objects yet to be generated from each chunk’s cameras 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}_{k} .
The layout video shows where each object belongs in every frame and anchors the camera to its path, even in unseen regions.
To indicate what each box contains, we render it in a color unique to its label and name the object of each color in the text prompt ( e.g . , “the light violet box is a long table” in Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh:
布局视频和文本提示 。 我们通过布局视频将视频模型设置在布局上,这使得每个块的相机C k\ mathcal{C}_{k}中尚未生成的物体箱成为了条件.
布局视频显示每个物体在每一帧中属于何处,并将相机固定在它的路径上,甚至在看不见的区域.
为了说明每个盒子中包含什么,我们将它变成其标签所特有的颜色并命名文本提示中每个颜色的对象(例如,图2中的“光紫色盒子是一个长的表格”)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Scene Memory
blocks.zh: 3.2 场景记忆

blocks.en:
As the video model keeps no state across chunks, we maintain a scene memory of everything observed or generated so far, as a colored point cloud 𝒫 \mathcal{P} and a bank ℋ \mathcal{H} of posed frames.
We initialize it by reconstructing the input views [ 38 , 69 , 68 ] .
blocks.zh:
由于视频模型没有在块间保持状态,所以我们保持了迄今为止所观察到或生成的一切的场景内存,作为彩色点云 P\mathcal{P}和被提交帧的银行 H\mathcal{H}.
我们通过重建输入视图来初始化它 [38, 69, 68].

blocks.en: Memory video. To show the video model what the scene already contains, we render the point cloud 𝒫 \mathcal{P} from each chunk’s cameras 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}_{k} , as in prior geometry-conditioned video models [ 54 , 12 , 95 ] , and provide the resulting memory video as a reference video.
blocks.zh: 记忆视频. 为了显示画面中已经包含的内容, 我们从每个块的相机 Ck\ mathcal{C}_{k} 中将点云 P\ mathcal{P} 制作出来,

blocks.en:
Appearance references. As point renderings lack fine detail, we also provide a few frames of ℋ \mathcal{H} as reference images.
We select the frames whose views overlap the most with the chunk’s cameras, similar to Lyra2 [ 57 ] , and provide details in the supplement.
blocks.zh:
外相参引. 由于点渲染缺乏细微的细节,我们还提供了几帧H\ mathcal{H}作为参考图像.
我们选择其观点与块相机最相重叠的相框,

blocks.en:
Memory update. To let later chunks build on what has been generated, we add each chunk to the memory once it is complete.
We reconstruct a subset of its frames with Pi3X [ 69 , 68 ] together with frames of the previous chunk, and align the reconstruction to the memory with a similarity transform fitted on these shared frames [ 63 ] .
To keep misaligned geometry out of the memory, we accept the update only if the aligned cameras deviate from the requested ones by at most 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} in rotation and a quarter of their spread in translation.
We then add the new points to 𝒫 \mathcal{P} and the frames to ℋ \mathcal{H} .
A chunk that fails this test remains in the video but leaves the memory unchanged.
blocks.zh:
记忆更新. 为了让以后的块建立在已经生成的东西上,我们在每个块完成后再添加到内存中.
我们用 Pi3X [69, 68] 来重建其框架的子集,加上以前的块的相框,并将重建与内存相配合,并安装在这些共享相框上的类似变换[63].
为了不让内存错位几何,我们只接受更新,只有当对齐相机在旋转时最多15分之15分之15分之15分之12分之15分之15分之15分之15分之15分之15分之15分之15分之15分之1分之1分之1分之1分之1的翻译时才接受更新.
然后,我们将新的分数添加到 P\ mathcal{P} , 框则添加到 H\ mathcal{H} 。
这个测试失败的块仍留在视频中,但内存保持不变.

blocks.en:
Layout update. To keep the layout consistent with what has been generated, we then update it against the memory.
We exclude the boxes of objects that the point cloud now shows in full from the layout video, and refit the boxes of partially generated objects to their points, so that the remainder of each object continues the part that exists.
All other boxes remain as planned.
blocks.zh:
版式更新 。 为了保持布局与已经生成的一致,我们然后对照内存更新.
我们把点云现在全部显示的物体盒从布局视频中排除出,再将部分生成的物体盒重置到其点上,使每个物体的剩余部分延续所存在的部分.
其他所有箱子都保持原计划。

blocks.en: 3.3 Video Model
blocks.zh: 3.3 视频模型

blocks.en:
Model. We start from a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion model (MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA [ 51 ] ), freeze its VAE and Qwen3-VL encoder [ 3 ] , and fine-tune its transformer with LoRA [ 30 ] via the original flow matching objective [ 45 ] .
As the model natively supports reference images and videos, we provide the layout and memory videos as reference videos and the appearance references as reference images.
blocks.zh:
型号。 我们从预先训练的双向视频传播模型(MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA [51])开始,冻结其VAE和Qun3-VL编码器[3],并用LORA[30]通过原来的流量匹配目标来微调其变压器. [45].
由于模型在本土上支持了参考图像和视频,我们提供布局和内存视频作为参考视频,外观参考作为参考图像.

blocks.en:
Prefix frame. To maintain temporal coherence across chunks, each chunk starts from a prefix frame: an input view for the first chunk, and the last frame of the previous chunk for every other.
The prefix frame also serves as an additional appearance reference.
The supplement describes how we stabilize the transitions between chunks at inference.
blocks.zh:
前缀框. 为了在块之间保持时间上的一致性,每个块都从前缀框架开始:第一个块的输入视图,另一个块的上个块的最后一个框架。
前缀框也作为外观参考.
补充说明我们如何稳定推断的块之间的过渡。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Directed round trips. Given the same start frame, cameras, and descriptions ( top ), we plot each method’s rotation error along the way out over the 20 CA-1M scenes ( left ) and show five cameras of one round trip with each frame’s error ( right ). The baselines drift once the path leaves the start view (by roughly 20–40 ∘ at its end), as does our model without its layout (dotted). Lyris is the only method to follow the path throughout, staying within 4 ∘ 4^{\circ} of the requested cameras.
blocks.zh: 图4:定向往返. 基于相同的起动相框、相机和描述(上), 我们用20个 CA-1M 场景(左) 绘制每条相机的旋转出错, 基线在路径离开起始视图后会漂移(在它的末尾大约为20–40 ∘),我们的模型没有它的布局(被点出)也是如此. Lyris是唯一能沿着这条路走下去的方法,

blocks.en:
Camera embedding. The memory and layout videos convey the camera motion only where they show content.
To provide camera control even when both are entirely empty, we encode the cameras 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}_{k} as Plücker rays [ 26 ] and add them to the tokens of the target and reference frames via a linear layer in each transformer block.
We zero-initialize these layers to ensure compatibility and stability with the pretrained initialization.
blocks.zh:
摄像头嵌入。 内存和布局视频只在显示内容时才传达相机运动.
为了提供相机控制,即使两者都是完全空的,我们把相机Ck\mathcal{C}_{k}编码为Plücker射线 [26],并通过每个变压器块的一线性地层将相机和参考帧加到标分上.
我们对这些地层进行零初始化,以确保与预训初始化的兼容性和稳定性.

blocks.en:
Training. We construct training examples from captured clips of ScanNet++ [ 83 ] and DL3DV [ 44 ] , treating each clip as one chunk and its first frame as the prefix frame.
We render the memory video from geometry estimated from the input views instead of ground truth, so that the model must learn to handle the incomplete coverage and reconstruction artifacts that it encounters at inference.
We derive the layout video from the 3D instance annotations of ScanNet++, using the boxes of objects visible beyond the first frame, and omit it for DL3DV clips, which provide no such annotations.
We also drop the memory and layout videos independently with probability 0.2 0.2 each (and the text prompt with probability 0.1 0.1 ), so that a single model can generate from any subset of these conditions.
blocks.zh:
培训。 我们从ScanNet++ [83] 和DL3DV [44] 的抓取片段中构建培训实例,将每个片段作为一个块来对待,并将第一个框作为前缀框.
我们从输入视图中 而不是从地面真相中 估算出几何的记忆视频 这样模型就必须学会处理 它在推断时遇到的不完整的覆盖和重建文物
我们从ScanNet++的3D实例说明中获取出布局视频,使用第一帧以外可见对象的框,并省去DL3DV剪辑,这些剪辑没有提供此类说明.
我们还将内存和布局视频独立地降下,每段概率为0.2 0.2 (以及文字提示为概率为0.1 0.1 ),这样一个模型就可以从这些条件的任何子集中生成.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
As our goal is to extend captured scenes well beyond what was observed while remaining consistent upon return, we evaluate Lyris on long round-trip trajectories.
We first give every method the same detailed description of what lies ahead, and assess how well each generates it ( Sec. 4.2 ).
Exploring a new scene usually comes without such descriptions, so in Sec. 4.3 , we only provide the caption of the start frame, and we assess whether planning what lies ahead with a vision-language model is
more effective than leaving it purely to the video model.
We validate the contribution of individual components and measure how closely Lyris follows its layouts in Sec. 4.4 .
blocks.zh:
由于我们的目标是把捕捉到的场景远远超出所观察到的场景,同时在返回时保持一致性,我们评价了赖瑞斯的长跑轨迹.
我们首先对每一种方法都作同样的详细说明,并评估每种方法产生的效果(第4.2节)。
探索新场景时通常没有这样的描述,因此在4.3 Sec中,我们只提供起动框架的字幕,我们评估未来是否有视觉语言模型的计划.
比把它完全留给视频模型更有效
我们验证各个组成部分的贡献,并衡量Lyris在第4.4节中如何接近其布局。

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: Table 1 : Directed layouts. All methods generate a 744-frame round trip from the same start frame, cameras, and descriptions. Lyris outperforms all baselines on every metric on both datasets, and follows the requested cameras more than four times as accurately as the next-best method (SolarWM-H3). We highlight the best , second-best , and third-best results.
blocks.zh: 表1:定向布局. 所有方法都从同一个起动帧,相机,和描述中产生出744帧的回程. Lyris在两个数据集的每个公分量上都超过了所有基线,并跟随所请求的相机的精确度是次佳方法(SolarWM-H3)的四倍多. 我们强调最佳、第二好和第三好的结果。

blocks.en:
Implementation. We fine-tune MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA [ 51 ] with rank-32 LoRA on its attention and feed-forward layers, using 124-frame clips at 832 × 480 832\times 480 resolution from 9,926 9{,}926 DL3DV-10K [ 44 ] and 747 747 ScanNet++ v2 [ 83 ] scenes (the latter of which provide object annotations).
We train on clips that start from one to five input views for 1,500 1{,}500 iterations using AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} on 128 H100 GPUs.
We then add clips that continue from a previous one for another 500 500 iterations (so that the model learns to build on its memory and retrieved references), and distill the resulting model into a few-step student via DMD2 [ 84 ] .
We use MoGe-3 [ 38 ] to lift single frames, Pi3X [ 69 , 68 ] to reconstruct multiple frames, GPT-6 to caption the training clips, and Claude Opus 5.5 to plan layouts.
At test time, we retrieve three appearance references per chunk and sample with eight steps and no guidance.
We provide more details in the supplement.
blocks.zh:
执行。 我们微调了MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA[51],在它的注意力上和向上分层上标有-32 LORA的分级,使用124帧剪辑,从9,926 9{,}926 DL3DV-10K [44]和747 747 ScanNet++v2 [83] 场景中以832×480 832\时间标出480分的分辨率(后者提供了对象说明).
在128个H100 GPU上, 我们用1500 1{,}500次重排, 使用 AdamW 进行从1到5个输入视图开始的剪辑训练。
然后,我们添加了从前作继续的片段,用于另外500个重复(这样模型就学会了在其内存上再取回参考文献),并通过DMD2[84]将由此产生的模型分馏成几个步骤的学生.
我们使用 MoGe-3 [38] 来提升单帧, Pi3X [69, 68] 来重建多帧, GPT-6 来给训练剪辑字幕, Claude Opus 5.5 来规划布局.
在测试时,我们检索到每个块和样本的3个外观参考,有8个步骤,没有指引.
我们在补编中提供了更多细节。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Autonomous exploration. All methods receive only the start frame, its caption, and the cameras. Lyris outperforms all baselines on every metric on all four datasets, including the in-the-wild videos of SpatialVID. Metrics and highlighting follow Tab. 1 , without Objects, which requires descriptions. Gray: Lyris with its layout planned for the whole camera path before generation, instead of chunk by chunk.
blocks.zh: 表2 自主勘探. 所有方法都只接收起步相框,其标题和相机. Lyris在所有四个数据集的每个度量上都超过了所有基线,包括SpaceVID所拍摄的多维视频. 测量和突出显示跟随 Tab. 1, 不包含对象, 这需要描述 。 Gray:Lyris的布局规划了整个相机路径在生成前,而不是被块分.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Autonomous round trips. Given only the start frame, its caption, and the cameras, we plot each method’s consistency upon return (Revisit) against the frames between the two visits ( left ) and show two cameras on the way out and back ( right ). We average over the 40 CA-1M and ScanNet++ round trips and leave out views that the start frame shows, so that no method can copy its input. As the gap grows, the baselines return to shifted views or changed objects (such as WorldCrafter’s ceiling light, dashed), and our model without its layout loses consistency as well (dotted). Lyris is the only method to return to the content it generated, even over 600 frames later.
blocks.zh: 图5:自主往返旅行。 仅从起始框、标题和相机来看, 我们平均在40次CA-1M和ScanNet++的回程旅行中留下起始帧显示的视图,这样任何方法都无法复制其输入. 随着差距的扩大,基线返回到改变视图或改变对象(例如WorldCrafter的天花板灯光被破灭),我们没有布局的模型也失去了一致性(被点出). Lyris是唯一一种返回其所生成内容的方法,甚至后来超过600帧.

blocks.en:
Round trips. Each round trip follows the cameras of a real capture for up to 372 frames on the way out and retraces them on the way back, for a total of up to 744 frames, or about one minute of video at 12 fps.
On average, the start frame observes only 29% of the pixels on the way out, leaving the rest to be generated, and the way back tests whether a method remembers what it generated there.
In the directed setting ( Sec. 4.2 ), every method receives a detailed description of each 124-frame window of the path, written by GPT-6 from the captured video, and in the autonomous setting ( Sec. 4.3 ) only a caption of the start frame.
All evaluation scenes are held out from training.
blocks.zh:
圆行. 每次来回都跟随真实捕捉到的相机出道时可达372帧并回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回
平均来说,起始帧在出道时只观测到29%的像素,剩下的则留作生成,而回路则测试一种方法是否记得它在那里产生的.
在定向设置(sec 4.2)中,每一种方法都得到路径每个124帧窗口的详细描述,由GPT-6从被捕获的视频中写出,在自发设置(sec 4.3)中只得到起始帧的字幕.
所有评价场景都从培训中进行。

blocks.en:
Baselines. We compare Lyris to recent video generation methods that differ in how they leverage memory, namely AnyRecon [ 12 ] , GEN3C [ 54 ] , and Spatia [ 95 ] , which condition on point-cloud renderings, Lyra2 [ 57 ] , which instead establishes dense correspondences to history frames through per-frame geometry, and WorldCrafter [ 88 ] , which queries an implicit 3D-aware memory.
We also compare to SolarWM-H3 [ 32 ] , a camera-controlled world model that builds on MiniMax-H3 as we do.
All six baselines leave unseen regions directly to the video model.
We run the official code of each method with its default settings and the same start frame, cameras, and text as Lyris (except for AnyRecon, whose official code uses an empty prompt).
blocks.zh:
基线。 我们比较Lyris与近期的视频生成方法,这些方法在如何利用内存上有所不同,即AnyRecon [12],GEN3C [54],和Spatia [95], 以点-云渲染为条件,Lyra 2 [57], 转而通过每帧几何来建立与历史框架的密集对应,以及WorldCrafter [88], 询问隐含的3D-意识内存.
我们还比较了SolarWM-H3[32],一个相机控制的世界模型,它以我们一样的迷你Max-H3为基础.
所有6个基线都直接由视频模型决定。
我们运行每种方法的官方代码,其默认设置和与Lyris相同的起始帧,相机,和文本(AnyRecon除外,其官方代码使用空快取).

blocks.en:
Metrics. We measure camera accuracy as the rotation and translation errors (RotErr, TransErr) between the input cameras and those that Depth Anything 3 (DA3) [ 42 ] recovers from the generated video, aligned at the first frame and up to scale, and report the imaging quality score of VBench [ 35 ] (Quality).
As content generated in unseen regions need not match the ground truth, we compute PSNR, SSIM [ 70 ] , and LPIPS [ 93 ] only over the pixels that the start frame observes, and measure consistency upon return as the DINOv2 [ 53 ] patch similarity between the two frames generated at each camera, over all revisited cameras (Revisit).
As the descriptions of Sec. 4.2 state what lies in unseen regions, we further report the fraction of the objects they name that a vision-language model finds in the generated video (Objects).
blocks.zh:
度量衡. 我们测量相机的准确性作为输入相机与深度Anything 3(DA3)[42]从所生成的相机中恢复的相机之间的旋转和翻译出错(RotErr, TransErr),在第一帧并达到比例,并报告V Bench [35] (质量)的成像质量分数.
由于在看不见的区域生成的内容不需要与地面真理相匹配,我们只计算启动帧所观察到的像素上的PSNR,SSIM [70],和LPIPS [93],并在返回时作为DINov2 [53] 补丁来测量每个相机生成的两个相机之间的相似性,在所有被重审相机上(Revisit).
由于第4.2条的描述说明了在看不见的区域中存在什么,我们进一步报告一个视觉语言模型在生成的视频(Objects)中发现的它们命名的物体的一小部分.

blocks.en: 4.2 Directed Layouts
blocks.zh: 4.2 定向布局

blocks.en:
Datasets. We evaluate on ScanNet++ [ 83 ] and CA-1M [ 40 ] as real indoor captures with LiDAR depth and 3D object annotations, which we use in Sec. 4.4 to measure how closely Lyris follows its layouts.
We test on 20 held-out scenes of the former and the 20 longest landscape captures of the latter, which Lyris is not trained on.
We provide additional results on DL3DV-Evaluation [ 44 ] (not overlapping with DL3DV-10K scenes) and from sparse input views in the supplement.
blocks.zh:
数据集. 我们在ScanNet++ [83] 和 CA-1M [40] 上评价为真实的室内捕捉器,并附有LiDAR深度和3D对象说明,我们在第4.4sec. 4中用它来测量Lyris遵循其布局的距离.
我们测试20个被搁置的场景 和20个最长的景观捕捉 后者, Lyris 没有受过训练。
我们在DL3DV-评价[44](不与DL3DV-10K场景相重叠)和从副刊中很少的输入视图中提供其他结果.

blocks.en:
Results. We summarize our results in Tab. 1 and show a qualitative comparison in Fig. 4 .
Lyris outperforms all baselines on every metric on both datasets, and follows the given cameras more than four times as accurately as the next-best method (SolarWM-H3).
The baselines drift from the path once it leaves the start view, as their memory offers nothing to anchor the camera in unseen regions, whereas Lyris renders its layout there ( Sec. 4.4 ).
Among the baselines, GEN3C best preserves the observed content through its explicit point cloud and WorldCrafter is the most consistent upon return through its implicit memory, but only our method achieves both by pairing a point cloud with retrieved appearance references.
blocks.zh:
结果。 我们在图一中总结了我们的成果,并在图一中作了定性比较。 4 (韩语).
Lyris在两个数据集的每个公分量上都超过了所有基线,并跟随给定相机的精确度是次佳方法(SolarWM-H3)的四倍多.
基线一旦离开起始视图就会从路径上漂出,因为它们的内存无法将相机固定在看不见的区域,而Lyris则将相机布局在那里(第4.4节)。
在基线中,GEN3C最能通过它的显点云来保存所观测到的内容,而WorldCrafter是通过其隐含的内存返回后最一致的,但只有我们的方法才能通过将取回的外观参考物来将点云配对来达到两者的目的.

blocks.en: 4.3 Autonomous Exploration
blocks.zh: 4.3 自主勘探

blocks.en:
Datasets. We evaluate on the ScanNet++ and CA-1M scenes of Sec. 4.2 along with DL3DV-Evaluation [ 44 ] as a benchmark of diverse indoor and outdoor scenes, and SpatialVID [ 65 ] as in-the-wild videos that Lyris is not trained on.
We again test on 20 scenes of each and provide additional details in the supplement.
blocks.zh:
数据集. 我们评价了ScanNet++和CA-1M的场景4.2以及DL3DV-评价[44]作为室内外各种场景的基准,以及SpaceVID[65]作为Lyris没有接受过训练的无线视频。
我们再次对每个场景的20个场景进行测试,并在补编中提供更多的细节。

blocks.en:
Results. We present quantitative results, using the same metrics as Tab. 1 , in Tab. 2 , and qualitative results in Fig. 5 .
Lyris outperforms all baselines on every metric on all four datasets.
Even without the descriptions of Sec. 4.2 , it outperforms every baseline that receives them on every metric ( Tab. 1 ), as its planner decides what lies ahead.
Lyris also generalizes to the in-the-wild videos of SpatialVID, where it outperforms SolarWM-H3, which is trained on this dataset, on every metric.
When the full camera path is available before generation, planning the layout for the whole path at once (Lyris w/ full path) further improves camera accuracy on CA-1M and SpatialVID, following the latter’s cameras more than three times as accurately as SolarWM-H3.
Averaged over the six blocks of Tabs. 1 and 2 , Lyris reduces the rotation error of each block’s best baseline by 3.8 × \times and improves on its Revisit by 22%.
blocks.zh:
结果。 我们采用与Tab. 1相同的衡量标准,在Tab. 2中提出定量结果,在图5中提出定性结果。
Lyris在所有四个数据集的每个度量上都超过了所有基线。
即使没有第4.2条的描述,它的表现也超过了每个衡量标准(表1)上得到的每一个基线,因为其规划者决定了未来。
Lyris还概括到SpaceVID的一团一团的视频中,其性能超过了SolarWM-H3,后者接受过关于这个数据集,每个度量的训练.
当全相机路径在生成前可用时,即刻规划全相机路径的布局(Lyris w/full path)会进一步提高CA-1M和SpaceVID上的相机精度,沿用后者的相机精确度是SolarWM-H3的三倍多.
平均在 Tabs 1 和 2 的 6 个区块上, Lyris 将每个区块最佳基线的自转误差减少 3.8 ×\% ,并将它的回访率提高 22% 。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation and Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 4.4 发育和诊断

blocks.en:
Components. We ablate our design decisions by individually omitting the major components of our method: the layout, the memory’s point cloud, and the appearance references.
We summarize our results in Tab. 3 .
The layout is crucial, as omitting it increases the rotation error roughly three- to sevenfold and lowers consistency upon return, both with or without a description.
Stating the layout only in the prompt, as the planner’s natural-language description of each chunk, instead of rendering it is far less effective, with a 2.8 × \times higher rotation error.
Omitting the memory’s point cloud degrades every metric, whereas omitting the appearance references mainly lowers consistency upon return.
Lyris also remains ahead of all baselines in camera accuracy and consistency upon return with a smaller planner (Claude Haiku 5.5), an open-weight one (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next), or the smaller Cosmos3-Nano [ 52 ] as its video model.
We provide these results in the supplement.
blocks.zh:
组件。 我们通过个别省略我们方法的主要组成部分来放弃设计决定:布局、记忆点云和外观参考。
我们在Tab中总结了我们的成果。 3 (英语).
版式至关重要,因为略去后,旋转出错将增加大约3至7倍,返回时一致性会降低,无论有无描述。
将布局只标出在即时, 因为规划者对每个块的自然语言描述, 而不是使其效果低得多,
刻出记忆点云会降低每个度量,而省去外观参考主要会降低返回时的一致性.
Lyris在返回时仍比所有基线在镜头准确性和一致性方面都领先于一个更小的计程器(Claude Haiku 5.5),一个开口重(Qune3.8-Flash-Next),或者较小的Cosmos3-Nano [52]作为其视频模型.
我们在补编中提供这些结果。

blocks.zh: 表3:读取研究。 我们评价CA-1M和ScanNet++的往返旅行。 这种布局对于有或没有说明的相机准确性至关重要,在提供时比在提示中说明时有效得多。

blocks.zh: 表4:布局遵守情况。 Tab. 1的定向回转得分,无论是否布局,都是用同一框的。 Lyris 将对象放置在指定其布局的地方,因此附加注释的布局会提高真实对象的回想.

blocks.en:
Layout control. To test whether the generation follows its layout, we edit a plan and regenerate with the same inputs and seed ( Fig. 6 ).
Moving a box moves its object and leaves its former place empty, and swapping two objects in the plan swaps them in the video, which lets a user edit the scene before it is generated.
Over the round trips of Tab. 1 , we further measure the fraction of each box that the generated surface fills (adherence), for the objects that the start frame does not show ( Tab. 4 ).
Lyris fills the boxes of its planned layout about a quarter more than when it generates without a layout.
Given the annotated layout of the real scene instead, Lyris follows it as well, and its content covers more of the real objects than without a layout (Recall).
blocks.zh:
布局控制。 为了检验这代人是否遵循了它的布局,我们编辑一个计划并用同样的输入和种子再生(图6.
移动一个盒子会移动其对象并留下其前所处空地,而将计划中的两个对象在视频中互换,让用户在生成前编辑场景.
在 Tab. 1 的圆行中,我们进一步测量生成的表面填充的每个框的分量( 坚持度) , 对于起始框未显示的对象( Tab. 4 ) 。
Lyris比在没有布局的情况下生成时多出四分之一左右的其计划布局的框.
考虑到真实场景的注解布局,Lyris也跟着它,其内容覆盖了更多的真实对象而不是没有布局(Recall).

blocks.en: Timing. Generating a 744-frame round trip takes about 28 minutes on a single H100 GPU, and planning its layout chunk by chunk adds a median of 10 minutes in the directed setting, for about 38 minutes end to end.
blocks.zh: 时机 产生744帧的回程需要约28分钟的单个H100GPU,并按块规划其布局会增加一个10分钟的中位数在定向设置中,大约38分钟结束到结束.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Lyris, a long video generation framework that pairs a persistent point-cloud memory with a 3D layout that a vision-language model authors for unseen regions.
The resulting loop preserves the existing scene while extending it according to the layout, and provides an explicit geometric interface for specifying what is generated.
On minute-long round trips across four datasets, Lyris reduces the camera error of state-of-the-art methods by 3.8 × \times .
blocks.zh:
我们提出了Lyris, 一个长长的视频生成框架, 它将一个持久的点-云记忆与一个3D布局, 一个视觉语言模型作者 为看不见的区域。
由此形成的回路在按照布局扩展时保留了已存在的场景,并提供了一个明确的几何界面来指定生成的内容.
在穿越4个数据集的短短回程中,Lyris将最新方法的相机出错减少3.8×\times.

blocks.en:
Limitations. Our method depends on the quality of the estimated geometry, as depth and alignment errors can accumulate in the memory and affect subsequent chunks.
Our model still requires multiple steps of diffusion sampling and is not yet interactive.
blocks.zh:
限制。 我们的方法取决于估计几何的质量,因为深度和对齐误差可以在内存中积累并会影响后续块.
我们的模型仍然需要多步骤的传播取样,而且还没有相互作用。

Lyris仍然是最一致的方法(Tab. 9 ),对于次好的方法(SolarWM-H3),其相似性为0.683 0.683相较于0.611 0.611相较.

blocks.en: A.6 Consistency vs. Camera Accuracy
blocks.zh: A.6 一致性与相机准确性

blocks.en: Table 10 : Consistency vs. camera accuracy. We recompute Revisit over only the frame pairs in which both frames have a rotation error of at most 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} , for every block of Tabs. 1 and 2 . Lyris remains the most consistent method in every block. Highlighting follows Tab. 1 .
blocks.zh: 表10:一致性与相机准确性. 我们只重新计算两个相框的相框对, 两个相框的自转误差最多为5分之5分之5分之2分, 每个相框的相框1分和相框2分。 Lyris仍然是每个街区最一致的方法. 标签1后面突出显示。

blocks.en:
As Revisit compares the two frames generated at each revisited camera, it also drops when a method deviates from the requested cameras.
To disentangle consistency from camera accuracy, we recompute Revisit over only the frame pairs in which both frames have a rotation error of at most 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} , and summarize our results in Tab. 10 .
Lyris remains the most consistent method in every block of Tabs. 1 and 2 ( 0.76 0.76 to 0.83 0.83 against at most 0.73 0.73 for the baselines).
blocks.zh:
由于Revisit比较了每台被重审相机生成的两个帧,当某一方法偏离所请求相机时也会下降.
将一致性与相机精确度区分开来,我们只重新计算两个相机的相框对相框的自转误差最多为5 ∘ 5 ^{\ Circ},并在 Tab. 10 中总结我们的结果.
Lyris仍然是每一块Tab. 1和2中最一致的方法(0.76 0.76至0.83 0.83,而基线最多0.73 0.73)。

blocks.en: A.7 Qualitative Ablation
blocks.zh: A.7 定性

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Qualitative ablation. We show the frames that Lyris and its ablations ( Tab. 3 ) generate at the same camera of a directed CA-1M round trip, on the way out and 217 frames later on the way back, with the DINOv2 similarity of the two frames (Revisit). We also show the layout video that each variant receives on the way out, and its memory video and appearance references on the way back. Lyris returns to the same content, whereas the camera drifts without the layout (RotErr of 93.9 ∘ 93.9^{\circ} at this camera), the content changes without the memory’s point cloud, and details change without the appearance references (circled).
blocks.zh: 图7:定性停产。 我们显示Lyris及其相片(Tab. 3 ) 在同一相机上生成的帧,这是一次直接的CA-1M回程,在出行的路上和后回的217帧,与两帧相类似(Revisit). 我们还展示了每个变体在出道时收到的布局视频,以及返回途中的记忆视频和外观参考. Lyris回到相同的内容,而相机漂移时没有布局(这台相机的RotErr of 93.9 ∘ 93.9^{\circ}),内容变化时没有内存点云,细节变化时没有外观参考(循环).

blocks.en:
We illustrate the ablations of Tab. 3 in Fig. 7 , at a camera that a directed CA-1M round trip visits on the way out and again on the way back.
Lyris generates the same content upon return.
Without the layout, the camera drifts from its path (with a rotation error of 93.9 ∘ 93.9^{\circ} at this camera, against 2.0 ∘ 2.0^{\circ} for Lyris) and views a different part of the scene.
Without the memory’s point cloud (and thus with a blank memory video), the appearance references alone do not preserve the scene, and the content changes upon return.
Conversely, the point cloud alone preserves the overall structure, but details change without the appearance references ( e.g . , the circled object that appears on the lid).
blocks.zh:
我们用一台CA-1M在出道时和回程时的回程访问的相机来说明图7中Tab. 3的伤痕。
Lyris 返回时生成相同的内容.
没有布局,相机会从它的路径上漂移(在此相机上旋转误差为93.9 ∘ 93.9 ^{\ Circ},而Lyris则取而代之的为2.0 ∘ 2.0 ^{\ Circ})并查看场景的另一部分.
没有记忆点云(因此带有空白的记忆视频),光是外观参考就无法保存场景,内容在返回时会改变.
反之,单点云保留了整体结构,但细节变化时没有外观参考(例如,盖上出现的被盘旋的物体).

blocks.en: A.8 Layout Editing
blocks.zh: A.8 版式编辑

blocks.en:
As our layout consists of one labeled box per object, a user can directly edit it to control what Lyris generates.
In unseen regions, the boxes determine what is generated and where, and moving, swapping, or adding them changes the content accordingly ( Fig. 6 ).
In the existing scene, objects are also stored in our memory, which we thus edit along with the layout.
As this memory is an explicit point cloud, we simply move an object’s points together with its box, and hide the points that a new box occludes.
Although Lyris is trained only on static scenes, we find that moving a box over time also moves its object in the generated video ( e.g . , a chair sliding away from a wall or a ball rolling across the floor).
We illustrate each of these edits on our project page.
blocks.zh:
由于我们的布局由每个对象一个有标签的框组成,用户可以直接编辑来控制Lyris生成的东西.
在看不见的区域,框会决定什么是生成的,在哪里和移动,互换,或添加,从而改变内容(图6)。
在现有场景中,物体也存储在我们的记忆中,因此我们随同布局一起编辑.
由于这个记忆是一个明确的点云,我们只是将一个物体的点和它的盒子一起移动,并隐藏新盒子所占据的点.
虽然莱里斯只接受静态场景的训练,但我们发现随时间推移而移动的盒子也会在生成的视频中移动它的对象(例如从墙上滑走的椅子或从地上滚过一球).
我们在项目网页上逐一举例说明这些编辑。

blocks.en: Appendix B Method Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 方法细节

blocks.en: B.1 Layout Planning
blocks.zh: B.1 版式规划

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Planner output. We show three of the boxes that the planner adds in the second chunk of a CA-1M round trip, without their colors and justifications. Each box is fully specified by a label, a center and size in meters, and a rotation about the gravity axis in degrees.
blocks.zh: 图8:规划员产出。 我们展示三个箱子 计划员加 在第二块 CA-1M 往返旅行, 没有他们的颜色和理由。 每个盒由标签,以米为中心与大小,并围绕重力轴以等分来旋转来充分指定.

blocks.en:
Planning. We use Claude Opus 5.5 as our planner, although Lyris also outperforms all baselines with smaller and open-weight planners ( Sec. A.2 ).
As our layout only requires one labeled box per object, we simply query the planner with fixed prompts, without tools or fine-tuning.
It first localizes each object visible in the start frame with a 2D bounding box, which we lift to 3D by fitting a box to the memory points within it.
To place the objects that the chunk should reveal, we render the point-cloud memory and the fitted boxes from above and from four of the chunk’s cameras, overlaid with a metric grid so that the planner can specify each new box in metric coordinates ( Fig. 8 ).
Similar to LayoutGPT [ 22 ] , we retrieve two layouts with matching objects from the annotated ScanNet++ scenes of our training set as in-context examples, and provide median object sizes.
blocks.zh:
规划。 我们使用克洛德·奥普斯·5.5作为我们的规划者,尽管Lyris也以较小和开放重量的规划者(Sec.A.2.)超越了所有基线。
由于我们的布局只需要每个对象一个有标签的盒子,所以我们只是用固定的提示,没有工具或微调来查询计划员.
它首先将起始框中可见的每个对象本地化,并配有2D边框,我们通过在它内部的内存点上安装一个框来将其提升到3D.
为了放置块应显示的物体,我们从上方和块的相机上制取出点-圆形的内存和装有相机的相机箱,并用一个度量网格来覆盖,以便规划人员可以在度量坐标(图8)中指定每个新相机箱。
与布局GPT [22] 类似,我们从我们训练集的附加说明的ScanNet++场景取回了两个配对对象的布局,并提供了中位对象大小.

blocks.en: Table 11 : Geometric checks. We verify each box that the planner proposes with the six checks of Sec. 3.1 . Their tolerances are the same for every scene and dataset.
blocks.zh: 表11:几何检查。 我们验证每个箱子 计划员提出 与六张支票SEC。 3.1 (中文(简体) ). 它们的耐受性对每个场景和数据集都是一样的.

blocks.en:
Verification. We sample five proposals and verify each with the six geometric checks of Sec. 3.1 , whose criteria we list in Tab. 11 .
We select the proposal with the fewest violations and let the planner revise it once, after which the deterministic repair resolves the remaining violations by displacing each flagged box as little as possible.
Finally, we remove the placed boxes that are still not visible, collide with another box, or contradict a stated relation.
The checks use the same tolerances for every scene and dataset. They are mainly for gross errors, and their exact values are not critical, as Lyris is robust to imprecise boxes.
Even when we perturb the final boxes with Gaussian noise (standard deviations of up to 0.3 0.3 m, 25%, and 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} in position, size, and orientation), the rotation error on the directed CA-1M round trips increases by less than 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} , and Lyris still outperforms all baselines on every metric of Tab. 1 .
blocks.zh:
核查。 我们抽取了5个提案,并用我们Tab. 11中列出的标准第3.1条的6个几何检查来核实每个提案。
我们以最少的违反行为选择这项提案,并让规划人员修改一次,然后确定性的修复通过尽可能少地取代每个标有标记的盒子来解决剩余的违反行为。
最后,我们取出那些仍不可见、与另一个盒子相撞或与所述关系相矛盾的放入的盒子。
检查对每个场景和数据集使用相同的容能. 它们主要用于重大错误,其准确值并不重要,因为Lyris对不准确的框很强.
即使我们用高斯语噪声(标准偏差可达0.3米、25%和20 ∘ 20^{\Circ}在位置、大小和方向上)扰动最后的箱子,定向CA-1M回程的旋转误差仍会增加不到1∘ 1^{\Circ},而Lyris仍然比Tab的每个度量上的所有基线都差. 1 (英语).

blocks.en:
Autonomous setting. Given only a caption of the input view, the planner itself decides which objects each chunk should reveal, and writes the chunk’s description from the resulting layout.
When the full camera path is available before generation (Lyris w/ full path in Tab. 2 ), it instead plans the layout for the whole path at once, from the input views and the cameras of all chunks.
blocks.zh:
自主设置. 仅考虑到输入视图的一个标题,规划者自己决定每个块应显示哪些对象,并从所产生的布局中写入块的描述。
当完整相机路径在生成前可用(Lyris w/ full profession in Tab. 2)时,它转而从所有块的输入视图和相机中同时规划整个路径的布局.

blocks.en: B.2 Layout Rendering and Update
blocks.zh: B.2 布局制作和更新

blocks.en:
Rendering. As the text prompt refers to each box by its color, we render the boxes of each training clip in perceptually distinct named colors, which we sample at random for each clip.
As each training clip contains at most 12 boxes, we likewise render at most 12 boxes per chunk at inference, and sample a palette of 12 colors once per path.
Each label thus retains its color across chunks, and a path with more than 12 labels reuses colors across chunks while keeping those within each chunk distinct.
blocks.zh:
发作. 由于文字提示按每个盒子的颜色来表示,我们把每个训练片段的盒子用明显不同的命名颜色来制作,我们随机抽取每个片段。
由于每个训练剪辑最多包含12个盒,我们同样在每块推想中最多提供12个盒,并抽取每个路径12个颜色的调色板。
因此,每个标签都保留了分块的颜色,一个带有12个以上标签的路径将分块的颜色重复使用,同时将每一块内的颜色区分开来。

blocks.en:
Update. As the memory video already shows what has been generated, the layout video prioritizes rendering only what has not.
Before each subsequent chunk, we thus measure how much of each object the memory contains, as the fraction of its box’s pixels that are covered by memory points inside the box.
Above 0.8, we consider the object fully generated and exclude its box.
Between 0.1 and 0.8, we consider it partially generated and refit its box to the largest cluster of memory points around it, so that the remainder of the object continues the part that exists.
As this cluster can include neighboring surfaces ( e.g . , the wall behind the object), we preserve the orientation of the box and allow each side to grow by at most 1.5 × 1.5\times .
Otherwise, the object is yet to be generated and its box remains as planned.
When more than 12 boxes remain, we prioritize those planned in unseen regions over those fitted to visible objects, as the prefix frame already shows the latter.
blocks.zh:
更新。 由于内存视频已经显示已生成的内容,布局视频只优先渲染未生成的内容.
在接下来的每个块之前, 我们以此来测量内存中包含的每个对象的多少, 作为其框内存储点覆盖的像素的分量 。
在0.8以上,我们认为该物体是完全产生的,并排除了它的盒子。
在0.1到0.8之间,我们认为它部分地生成并重置了盒子到周围最大的一组内存点上,这样剩下的物体就可以延续所存在的部分.
由于这个集群可以包括相邻的表面(例如物体后方的墙),所以我们保留了盒子的取向并允许每一边最多能长出1.5×1.5\时.
否则,该对象尚未生成,而其盒子仍如所计划.
当剩下超过12个盒子时,我们把那些在看不见区域规划的盒子放在那些装有可见物体的盒子之上,因为前缀框架已经显示后者。

blocks.en: B.3 Reference Retrieval
blocks.zh: B.3 检索参考资料

blocks.en:
From the bank ℋ \mathcal{H} of input views and previously generated frames, we retrieve up to three appearance references per chunk, selected to maximize their joint coverage of the chunk’s views.
For each frame i i in ℋ \mathcal{H} , we project its estimated depth into every eighth camera of the chunk to obtain the set 𝒱 i \mathcal{V}_{i} of pixels that it observes, with a depth test for occlusion.
As each chunk already receives its prefix frame, we initialize the selection ℛ \mathcal{R} with it and greedily add the frame that maximizes the additional coverage, i ∗ = arg ⁡ max i ∉ ℛ ​ | 𝒱 i ∖ ⋃ j ∈ ℛ 𝒱 j | . i^{*}=\underset{i\notin\mathcal{R}}{\arg\max}\bigl|\mathcal{V}_{i}\setminus\textstyle\bigcup_{j\in\mathcal{R}}\mathcal{V}_{j}\bigr|. (1) Once no frame increases the coverage, we select the remaining references by the proximity of their cameras to the chunk’s.
When a chunk returns close to the start of the path, we additionally include the first input view, so that the chunk is conditioned on the captured view itself.
blocks.zh:
从输入视图和先前生成的框架的库 H\ mathcal{H} 中, 我们检索到每个块最多3个外观参考,
对于H\ mathcal{H}中的每一帧i,我们将其估计的深度投射到块中每八相机中,以获得它观察到的像素的设定 V I\ mathcal{V}_{i},并进行隔离的深度测试.
由于每个块已经收到其前缀框,我们用它来初始化选择 R\ mathcal{R} 并且贪婪地添加了能够最大限度扩大额外覆盖的框, i * = arg 最大 i = * * * i = * * * i = * * * i = * * j = * *. i\ n underset{ mathcal{ R}}{\arg\ max\ bigl\ mathcal{ V}_{j}\bigr} 。 (1) 一旦没有框架能增加覆盖面,我们就会通过他们的相机接近块来选择其余的参考文献。
当一个块返回接近路径开始时,我们额外包括第一个输入视图,这样该块就以被捕获的视图本身为条件.

blocks.en: B.4 Memory Update
blocks.zh: B.4 内存更新

blocks.en:
We initialize the memory with the monocular depth [ 38 ] of the first input view, and reconstruct any further input views jointly with Pi3X [ 69 , 68 ] .
As errors in this memory would persist for the rest of the video, we align each chunk to it, add only the points that are reliable and not yet contained in it, and discard the update altogether if the alignment deviates from the requested cameras.
blocks.zh:
我们以第一个输入视图的单相深度[38]来初始化内存,并和Pi3X[69,68]联合重建任何进一步的输入视图.
由于这段内存中的错误将持续到视频的其余部分,因此我们将每个块都与它对齐,只添加可靠且尚未包含在其中的分数,如果对齐偏离了所要求的相机,则完全放弃更新.

blocks.en:
Alignment. We reconstruct every eighth frame of the chunk with Pi3X, conditioned on the requested cameras, together with frames that the memory already contains, and fit a similarity transform [ 63 ] to the 3D points of these shared frames.
With a single input view, the first chunk shares no reconstructed frame with the memory, and we instead fit the transform to its camera centers.
As these alone can misestimate the scale, we then rescale the reconstruction to the depth of the input view.
blocks.zh:
对齐 我们用 Pi3X 重建了块的每8个相框, 以请求的相机为条件, 加上内存中已经包含的相框, 并装入一个相似性 转换到这些共享相框的 三维点 。
以单一的输入视图,第一个块没有与内存共享重建的相框,我们转而将变相放入相机中心.
由于仅靠这些可以错误估计规模,我们然后将重建调整到输入视图的深度.

blocks.en:
Filtering. From each reconstructed frame, we first discard the points with low Pi3X confidence or at depth discontinuities, where the reconstruction is least reliable.
To keep a single copy of each surface, we then render the current point cloud into the frame’s camera and discard the points whose depth agrees with the rendered depth within a relative tolerance.
We likewise discard the points that lie on or in front of the surfaces observed by the first input view, as they would duplicate or contradict this captured view, and add the remaining points to 𝒫 \mathcal{P} .
To ensure that the memory video still covers the entire prefix frame of the next chunk, we also lift this frame with monocular depth, scaled to the memory, and render its points wherever the memory provides none.
blocks.zh:
滤取. 从每一个被重建的框架,我们首先丢弃Pi3X信心低或深度不连续的点,因为重建最不可靠。
为了保存每个地表的单一副本,我们将目前的点云放入相框的相机中,并丢弃深度与相对容力范围内的深度一致的点。
我们同样放弃第一个输入视图所观测到的表面上或前面的点,因为它们会重复或与所捕获的视图相矛盾,并将所余点添加到 P\ mathcal{P} 中.
为了确保内存视频仍然覆盖下个块的整个前缀框架,我们还以单相片深度抬起这个帧,缩放到内存上,并在内存没有提供的地方将其分出.

blocks.en:
Acceptance test. We accept the update only if the median rotation between the aligned and the requested cameras is at most 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} and the root-mean-square error of their centers is at most 0.25 times the cameras’ spread, i.e . , the root-mean-square distance of the centers from their mean.
As this spread vanishes when the camera turns in place, we use 0.2 times the median depth of the new frames instead whenever it is larger.
On the directed CA-1M round trips, 93% of the updates pass this test, against 78% without the layout, as the generated cameras then follow the requested ones less closely.
B.5 Chunk Transitions
blocks.zh: B.5 春克过渡

blocks.en:
We generate 124 frames per chunk and keep the first 107 (all but the last latent group of the video VAE, which has the lowest imaging quality), continuing the next chunk from the last frame that we keep.
As the model is trained with captured prefix frames, we sharpen this generated frame with an unsharp mask (radius of 2 pixels, amount of 70%) before it conditions the next chunk, while the output video retains the original frame.
In the first chunk, we also replace the latents that the memory video covers with its own (noised to the current level) after each of the first two of the eight sampling steps, which keeps the chunk aligned with the input views.
These choices slightly improve consistency upon return and imaging quality (by 0.026 and 1.5 on the directed CA-1M round trips of Tab. 1 , and by 0.021 and 1.4 on those of ScanNet++).
Without them, Lyris still outperforms all baselines in camera accuracy, consistency upon return, and imaging quality.
blocks.zh:
我们每块生成124帧,保留前107帧(除了视频VAE的最后一个潜在组,它具有最低的成像质量),继续我们保存的上个帧的下一块.
由于该模型是用被捕获的前缀框来训练的,我们用一个未变形的口罩(辐射为2像素,量为70%)来磨合这个生成的相框,然后才对下个块进行条件化,而输出视频则保留了原来的相框.
在第一个块中,我们还将内存视频所覆盖的潜伏物取而代之的是,在八个抽样步骤的前两个步骤中,每一个步骤都使块与输入视图保持了一致(通知到当前水平).
这些选择在返回和成像质量时略有改进(在Tab. 1的CA-1M定向回程中比0.026和1.5;在ScanNet++的回程中比0.021和1.4)。
没有它们,Lyris在镜头精确度、返回时的一致性和成像质量方面仍然超过了所有基线。

blocks.en: B.6 Architecture
blocks.zh: B.6 建筑

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Video model. The DiT processes the latents of the noisy target together with those of the memory video, the prefix frame and appearance references, and the layout video, and with the Qwen3-VL embedding of the text prompt, through joint self-attention. We freeze the VAE and Qwen3-VL, fine-tune the DiT with LoRA, and add only a zero-initialized linear layer per block that embeds the cameras 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}_{k} as Plücker rays.
blocks.zh: 图9:视频模式. DiT处理吵闹目标与内存视频的潜伏,前缀框和外观参考,以及布局视频,并用Quen3-VL嵌入文本快取,通过联合自取. 我们冻结了VAE和Quen3-VL,用LORA来微调DiT,每个区块只加入一个零初始的线性地层,将相机C k\mathcal{C}_{k}嵌入为普吕克射线.

blocks.en:
To preserve the prior of the pretrained model, we keep the architecture of MiniMax-H3 unchanged apart from the camera embedding, and provide all other conditions through its native reference inputs ( Fig. 9 ).
The VAE latents of these conditions thus enter the joint self-attention of the DiT as separate tokens, while the Qwen3-VL encoder embeds their frames together with the text prompt.
As the prefix frame is the first frame of the chunk, its tokens share the RoPE positions of the first target frame, whereas the appearance references keep separate positions.
For the camera embedding, we compute one Plücker ray per latent position, relative to the first target camera, averaging the cameras over the frames that each latent frame compresses.
Each target and reference-image token receives its rays at the self-attention input of every transformer block, through a linear layer that we zero-initialize so that training starts from the pretrained model.
blocks.zh:
为了保留预先训练的模型的前身,除了相机嵌入外,我们保持了MiniMax-H3的架构不变,并通过其本土参考输入(图9)提供所有其他条件.
因此,这些条件的VAE潜伏物作为单独的符号进入了DiT的联合自意,而Quen3-VL编码器则将它们的框与文本提示相嵌入.
由于前缀框是块的第一帧,它的符号共享了第一个目标框的RoPE位置,而外观参考文献则保留了独立的位置.
对于相机嵌入,我们计算一个普吕克射线 每个潜在位置,相对于第一个目标相机, 平均相机超过每个潜在相框压缩的相框。
每个目标和参考图像符号在每一个变压器块的自意输入时,通过一个线性地层得到它的射线,这个线性地层是我们零初始化的,以便训练从预先训练的模型开始.

blocks.en: B.7 Training and Distillation
blocks.zh: B.7 培训和消化

blocks.en:
Training. The two stages of Tab. 1 expose the model to each situation that it faces at inference.
Both stages use the optimizer of Tab. 1 , with gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 and one clip per GPU.
The first stage ( 1,500 1{,}500 iterations on 128 GPUs) covers first chunks, with an even mix of ScanNet++ clips and DL3DV clips that start from one to five input views.
In the second stage ( 500 500 iterations on 64 GPUs), 42.5% of the clips continue from a captured previous chunk, from which we build their memory and retrieve their references as at inference.
To cover returns, 20% play this previous chunk back in reverse and 12.5% do the same for an earlier chunk.
The remaining 25% are first-stage clips, which keeps first chunks in the training distribution.
blocks.zh:
培训。 塔布的两个阶段. 1让模型暴露在它所面对的每一种情况下.
两个阶段都使用Tab 1的优化器,梯度剪接为每GPU1.0和1个剪接.
第一阶段(1,500 1{,}500 迭接到128 GPU上)覆盖了先发块,由ScanNet++片段和从一到五个输入视图开始的DL3DV片段均匀混合.
在第二阶段(在64个GPU上500个重复),42.5%的片段继续取自之前抓取的片段,我们从中构建出他们的记忆并检索他们的参考文献作为推论.
为覆盖返回, 20% 将先前的块反向播放, 12.5% 对先前的块同样播放 。
其余25%是第一阶段剪辑,这在培训分配中保留了第一阶段。

blocks.en:
Condition dropout. We represent a memory video that is dropped during training ( Sec. 3.3 ) by the VAE encoding of an all-gray sequence, as for a memory without points.
We omit a dropped layout video together with the part of the prompt that names its boxes.
When we drop the text prompt, we retain the Qwen3-VL embeddings of the reference images and videos, so that classifier-free guidance acts on the text prompt alone.
blocks.zh:
条件中断。 我们代表一个记忆视频,在训练期间由全格蕾序列的VAE编码(Sec. 3.3)所掉入,对于一个没有分数的记忆.
我们省略了一个被丢弃的布局视频 连同提示中命名其盒子的部分
当我们放弃文本提示时,我们保留了引用图像和视频的 Quen3-VL 嵌入,这样,无分类的引导就只作用于文本提示.

blocks.en:
Distillation. To sample with only eight steps and without classifier-free guidance, we distill the second-stage model with DMD2 [ 84 ] on its training clips for 500 500 iterations on 32 GPUs, using it as the teacher at a guidance scale of 3.
Every fifth iteration updates the student (learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} ), and the others update the fake score model (a LoRA, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} ).
blocks.zh:
蒸发. 仅取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取
每五次重复一次更新学生(学习率10 - 5 10 - 5),其他人更新假分数模型(一个LORA,学习率10 - 4 10 - 4).

blocks.en: Appendix C Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录C 评价议定书

blocks.en: C.1 Evaluation Scenes
blocks.zh: C.1 评价

blocks.en:
We select the DL3DV and SpatialVID scenes of Tab. 2 from the captured footage and its metadata alone, independently of any method’s output.
For DL3DV, we use DL3DV-Evaluation [ 44 ] , a separately released test split 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/datasets/DL3DV/DL3DV-Evaluation that does not overlap with the DL3DV-10K scenes we train on.
As our task is a walkthrough at a natural pace from a single image, we exclude scenes with very fast camera motion and those whose start frame is dominated by dense vegetation, which leaves no clear path to walk through.
We then randomly sample 20 of the remaining scenes (16 indoor and 4 outdoor).
As the annotated clips of SpatialVID [ 65 ] last at most 15 s, which is too short for our round trips, we instead use its long raw videos (one clip per video) and estimate their cameras with ViPE [ 31 ] .
From these in-the-wild videos, we only keep ground-level walkthroughs of real, static scenes without overlaid text.
To ensure that camera errors are meaningful, we further require that DA3 [ 42 ] , with which we measure them, recovers the ViPE cameras from the captured footage to within 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} .
For a fair comparison, we also require enough sparse points in the start frame to calibrate the scale of the input cameras ( Sec. C.3 ), and exclude the footage that SolarWM-H3 [ 32 ] is trained on.
The 20 videos that pass all criteria (17 indoor and 3 outdoor) form our test set.
blocks.zh:
我们选择了Tab的DL3DV和SpaceVID场景. 与任何方法的输出无关。
对于DL3DV,我们使用DL3DV-评价 [44],一个单独发布的测试分拆 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/datasets/DL3DV/DL3DV-评价,不与我们训练的DL3DV-10K场景相重叠.
由于我们的任务是以自然的速度从一幅图像中走过,我们排除了镜头动作非常快的场景,以及那些以茂密的植被为主的起动框,这没有留下清晰的走过的道路.
然后我们随机抽取了其余的20个场景(16个室内和4个室外).
由于SpaceVID[65]的注解片段最长不超过15 s,而对于我们的来回旅行来说太短了,因此我们使用其长长的原始视频(每段视频一个片段),并用VIPE来估计他们的相机[31].
从这些模糊的视频中,我们只保留真实的,静态的场景的地平面走行部,而不覆盖文字.
为了保证相机误差有意义,我们进一步要求DA3 [42],我们用它来测量,从所摄取的相机中取回VIPE相机,在10 QQ 10 Circ}之内.
为了进行公平的比较,我们也要求起始相框中足够稀有的分数来校正输入相机的尺度(Sec. C.3),并排除SolarWM-H3[32]所训练的镜头.
通过了所有标准的20个视频(室内17个,室外3个)构成我们的测试集.

blocks.en: C.2 Metrics
blocks.zh: C.2 计量

blocks.en:
We score each method from its generated frames alone, without access to its internal cameras or geometry.
As the way back retraces the way out, we measure Revisit across the two and all other metrics on the way out, and average each over scenes.
blocks.zh:
我们只用它生成的相框来评分每一种方法,不能进入其内部相机或几何.
当返回的路重寻出路时, 我们测量了Revisit 横跨两个和所有其他的度量, 并平均每个场景。

blocks.en: Camera accuracy. As every method starts from the same frame, we align the cameras that DA3 3 3 3 DA3NESTED-GIANT-LARGE-1.1 on Hugging Face. recovers from each generated video with the input cameras at this frame only, such that the errors include any drift along the path, and fit a single scale to the recovered positions.
blocks.zh: 摄相机精度. 随着每一种方法都从同一个框架开始,我们把DA3 3 3 DA3NESTED-GIANT-LARGE-1.1上的相机对齐. 从每个产生的视频中只用这个帧的输入相机取回,使出错包括了沿路径的任何漂移,并安装到被取回位置的单个比例尺.

blocks.en:
Observed pixels. To restrict PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS to the pixels that the start frame observes, we determine these pixels from the capture, such that they are identical for every method.
A pixel is observed if its captured surface reprojects into the start frame within a relative depth tolerance of 10%, using the captured depth of CA-1M and ScanNet++ and MoGe-3 [ 38 ] depth scaled to the sparse points of DL3DV and SpatialVID.
blocks.zh:
所观察等相. 为了将PSNR,SSIM,和LPIPS限制在起始帧所观察到的像素上,我们从捕获中确定这些像素,这样每种方法都是一样的.
如果利用CA-1M和ScanNet++和MoGe-3[38]深度被捕获的深度放大到DL3DV和SpaceVID的稀有点,其捕获到的地表重投入相对深度可容忍度为10%的起始框架,则观测到一个像素.

blocks.en:
Consistency upon return. Revisit compares the two frames generated at each revisited camera directly, as the cosine similarity of their DINOv2-large patch features.
We exclude the cameras that are revisited within 48 frames (around the turn), as frames this close in time remain consistent without memory.
blocks.zh:
归来相相相相相相. 重访直接比较了每台重访相机产生的两帧相机,作为它们的DINOv2大补丁特性的同弦相近.
我们排除48个范围内(转弯一圈)重新审视的相机,因为这样接近的相机在时间上保持了一致,没有内存.

blocks.en:
Objects. As the judge should favor no method, we use Gemini 3.1 Pro at temperature 0 (a model that neither plans our layouts nor writes the descriptions), and withhold the name of the method.
We ask it which of the objects that each description names (as extracted by GPT-6) appear in 31 evenly spaced frames of the way out.
This judge finds 97.6% and 97.8% of the objects in the captured videos of ScanNet++ and CA-1M, and returns the same answer for 95.8% of the objects when queried a second time.
blocks.zh:
物体。 由于法官不应该赞成任何方法,因此我们在0温时使用双子座3.1 Pro(这个模型既不规划我们的布局,也不写描述),并保留方法的名称.
我们询问每个描述名称(由GPT-6取出)出现在31个平方相框中的对象。
这个判断器在被捕获的ScanNet++和CA-1M的视频中发现了97.6%和97.8%的对象,并在第二次被询问时返回95.8%对象的相同答案.

blocks.en:
Layout adherence. For Tab. 4 , we obtain the generated surface from the DA3 depth of the generated frames.
Adherence measures whether objects are generated where the layout places them, as the fraction of the pixel rays through a box at which this surface lies inside the box instead of behind it.
Recall measures whether the real objects are reproduced, as the fraction of the pixels showing an annotated object in the capture at which the generated surface also lies inside its box.
We average both over the boxes that the start frame does not observe, as the input shows the others.
blocks.zh:
布局坚持。 对于 Tab. 4, 我们从生成帧的 DA3 深度获得生成的表面 。
坚持度量对象是否在布局放置的地方产生,作为像素射线的分量通过一个框,这个表面位于盒子内而不是后面.
回顾是否复制真实对象的衡量标准,作为捕获中显示附加注释对象的像素分数,生成的表面也位于其框中.
在起始框没有观测到的框上,我们两个都平均,因为输入显示了其他的.

blocks.en: C.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: C.3 基线

blocks.en:
We run the official implementation of each baseline with its default settings, and generate each round trip in a single run with a fixed seed, so that every method relies on its own memory.
As the baselines generate between 17 and 121 frames at a time, we provide each step with the description of the corresponding part of the path (or the caption of the start frame in the autonomous setting).
AnyRecon is the only exception, as its official implementation uses an empty prompt, so its directed and autonomous round trips coincide.
To ensure that all methods receive the same camera path, we calibrate the scale of the input cameras once per scene from the sparse points visible in the start frame, and use it for every method.
Each baseline generates at its default resolution (at least 832 × 480 832\times 480 ), and we downsample all videos to 832 × 480 832\times 480 for evaluation, which, if anything, favors the baselines that generate at a higher resolution.
blocks.zh:
我们以默认设置运行每个基准的官方执行,并在一次运行中以固定种子生成每次回程,这样每个方法都依赖于自己的内存.
由于基线一次生成17到121帧之间,我们为每个步骤提供了路径相应部分的描述(或自主设置中起始帧的字幕).
AnyRecon是唯一的例外,因为其正式实施使用空出快取来,所以其定向和自主的回程正好相接.
为了确保所有方法都接收到相同的相机路径,我们从起始框所可见的稀有点对每个场景一次一次的输入相机的尺度进行校正,并用到每个方法.
每个基准产生默认分辨率(至少832 × 480 832\times 480),我们把所有视频都做为832 × 480 832\times 480用于评价,如果有的话,这有利于在更高分辨率下生成的基线.

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制

blocks.en:
As Lyris builds its memory from estimated geometry, depth and alignment errors can accumulate over very long paths.
Our acceptance test ( Sec. B.4 ) discards unreliable updates, and stronger reconstruction models are directly applicable to our method.
Lyris does not currently model dynamic scenes, as it is trained only on static captures.
However, moving a box over time already moves its object in the generated video ( Sec. A.8 ), which makes training on dynamic data a promising direction.
Our layout specifies only a labeled box per object, and thus offers no control over its detailed shape, which richer primitives rendered into the layout video could provide.
Finally, Lyris is not yet interactive, as planning and sampling run in sequence for every chunk, which faster planners and distillation into a causal model [ 14 ] could address.
blocks.zh:
随着Lyris通过估计几何来建立记忆,深度和对齐误差可以在很长的路径上积累.
我们的接受测试(Sec.B.4)放弃了不可靠的更新,更强大的重建模型直接适用于我们的方法.
Lyris目前不模拟动态场景,因为它只接受静态捕捉的培训.
然而,随着时间推移,一个盒子已经在生成的视频(Sec.A.8)中移动了它的对象,这使得动态数据培训成为一个很有希望的方向.
我们的布局只指定了每个物体的标签框,因此无法控制其详细的外形,而更丰富的原始的被制成布局视频可以提供这种外形.
最后,Lyris还不是互动的,因为规划和取样按顺序逐个块进行,更快的规划者和分解成一个因果模型[14]可以处理。

blocks.en: Appendix E Societal Impact
blocks.zh: 附录E 社会 影响

blocks.en:
Lyris generates explorable environments from as little as a single photo, which benefits applications such as virtual touring, content creation, and simulation for physical AI.
Its explicit layout further allows a user to inspect and edit what will be generated before any frame is rendered.
However, as Lyris plausibly extends real places beyond what was captured, it raises concerns about potential misuse for generating deceptive visual media ( e.g . , presenting a generated walkthrough as real footage).
Although Lyris is trained on static scenes and is not designed to synthesize people, appropriate safeguards such as watermarking generated content should be considered for deployment.
As Lyris builds on a pretrained video model and a vision-language planner, it also inherits the biases of their training data ( e.g . , toward common room types and furnishings).
blocks.zh:
Lyris从很少的一张照片中生成可扩展的环境,这有利于虚拟旅行,内容创建,物理AI模拟等应用.
其明确的布局进一步允许用户检查和编辑任何帧显示前将生成的内容.
然而,由于Lyris可以合理地将真实的地段延伸到被捕获的地段之外,它引起了人们对可能被滥用来产生欺骗性的视觉媒体(例如,将生成的行走作为真实的镜头)的担忧.
虽然Lyris在静态场景上接受训练,并非设计合成人,但应当考虑部署适当的保障措施,如水标记生成的内容.
由于Lyris以经过预先培训的视频模型和视觉语言规划师为基础,它也继承了他们培训数据的偏见(例如,面向共同房间类型和家具)。
